title: Scp-1048 The Builder Bear
style: green night-vision infrared camera footage, glowing white eyes reflecting the infrared light, grainy, bloom, vignette, photorealistic, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no watermarks, vertical composition

credit.author: trennerdios
credit.line: Based on SCP-1048 by trennerdios - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-1048 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: The cutest thing in Site 24 is also the deadliest. Would you have reported the bear?

Hero.look: short brown hair, dark Foundation jacket, seen from behind

scenes.image_prompt: Wide dark concrete corridor in green night vision footage, a tiny worn teddy bear silhouette far away at the end, large empty black area above, one faint infrared glow, photorealistic {style}

lines.text: In Site 24, a secret base for things that should not exist, a teddy bear thirty-three centimetres tall walks the halls alone.

scenes.label: WHAT IT DOES
scenes.image_prompt: Green night vision photo of a janitor's mop closet floor, a small crayon drawing on paper beside a mop bucket, tiny fabric footprints, no bear visible, one infrared light, photorealistic {style}

lines.text: It hugs people by the leg and draws them pictures, and everyone loves it, even convicts.

scenes.label: WHY IT'S DANGEROUS
scenes.image_prompt: Green night vision footage of a dark hallway floor, dropped guard helmets and radios, pale ear-shaped lumps scattered on the tiles, one infrared light, nothing else visible, photorealistic {style}

lines.text: But seven months later it started building copies. One, made of human ears, shrieked, and the guards suffocated beneath growing ears.

scenes.label: HOW IT'S CONTAINED
scenes.image_prompt: Green night vision photo of an empty containment room, door hanging open, a tiny chair and a small dusty handprint on the wall, one infrared light, photorealistic {style}

lines.text: Now the original has vanished somewhere inside the base, and the order is to destroy every copy on sight.

scenes.label: WHO WATCHES IT
scenes.image_prompt: Green night vision, far away, the back of {Hero} at a security desk with dark monitors, a tiny bear-shaped shadow on one screen, partly hidden by a pillar, one infrared light, photorealistic {style}

lines.text: So no teddy bears are allowed in at all, and anything shaped like one must be reported to security immediately.

scenes.label: THE MISTAKE
scenes.image_prompt: Green night vision, distant dim office, the back of {Hero} at a desk, a small stitched teddy bear with button eyes half hidden behind a crate in the far corner, one infrared light, photorealistic {style}

lines.text: And tonight, on watch, you see a small bear in the corner and decide it is only a toy.

scenes.image_prompt: Green night vision, dark bunk room, a sleeper's pillow and blanket, two small reflective button eyes low near the bedside, mostly black, stitched bear shape barely visible, one infrared light, photorealistic {style}

lines.text: Then you reach up, and your ear is gone, and the corner is empty.

scenes.image_prompt: Green night vision, extreme darkness, two glowing button eyes of a small stitched teddy bear very close to the lens, out of focus, split seams, lit by one infrared light, photorealistic {style}

lines.text: I am not the narrator. I have been reading you this file so you would stay still.
